:::{#thm-noise-second-moment}
#### The second moment of mean-zero noise

Let $\noise$ be a random variable with $\Ep[\noise] = 0$ and $\Var{\noise} = \varpar$.
Then

$$\Ep[\noise^2] = \varpar$$

:::

::: proof

This is the solution to @exr-noise-second-moment.
By @thm-variance, $\Var{\noise} = \Ep[\noise^2] - (\Ep[\noise])^2$.
Substituting $\Ep[\noise] = 0$ and solving for $\Ep[\noise^2]$,

$$
\begin{aligned}
\Ep[\noise^2]
&= \Var{\noise} + 0^2 \\
&= \varpar
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
